explained.summary: It’s absurd not to escape your own faults, which you can do, while trying to escape other people’s, which you can’t. Marcus is pointing his effort at the one place it can work: himself.
explained.today: Changing jobs to get away from a difficult colleague often leads to another difficult colleague. Working on your own impatience, by contrast, pays off wherever you go.
